## Valuation Insights

Costco’s fiscal 2026 net sales reached $297.2 billion, reflecting a 9.0% increase from the prior year’s $272.6 billion. This growth indicates steady expansion across its membership base and global footprint.
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=33] -->
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=32] -->
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=297.2;272.6|result=9.02%|definition=Revenue growth = (Current Revenue - Prior Revenue) / Prior Revenue] -->

The company generated $11.685 billion in operating income on that revenue, yielding an operating margin of approximately 3.9%. This margin is calculated as operating income divided by total net sales and indicates the profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss|period=2025-09-01/2026-08-30|value=11685000000] -->
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=33] -->
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=11685;29720|result=3.93%|definition=Operating margin = Operating Income / Total Net Sales] -->

Comparable sales growth for the fiscal year was 8.4% for the Total Company, with an adjusted figure of 6.6% excluding gasoline prices and foreign exchange. The Digitally-Enabled segment showed 20.9% growth, highlighting a significant digital channel contribution to overall performance.
